name: Resident Evil Outbreak — Greatest Hits Cheats
author: RaccoonRecomp
authors: Code Master, Lajos Szalay, Jay007, VirusPunk, Jarnold83 (codes, GameHacking.org)
47iscool (Character 2/3 (CPU) Modifier, Go It Alone, Walk Through Walls)
description:
All of the Greatest Hits cheats for your disc (SLUS-20765 v2.00, which has the Greatest Hits memory layout): the 19 cheats of your CodeBreaker v7 list, each its own option with its CodeBreaker code, plus the other codes of your Greatest Hits pnach (All Costumes, the collection and reward-point codes). Fixed for your disc where the code as written is wrong for it (Infinite Health, Infinite Item Usage, Max Infinite Ammo, Unlock All NPC's); save data gets only values the game itself can write. Infinite Time acts only in online play, which is not available yet; Infinite Rewards Points Usage and Max Inventory are not active.

Master Code: Enable Code (Must Be On) by Code Master (CodeBreaker v7+). It must be On for any of these cheats to apply; Off switches every cheat of this mod off and puts the game's original code back.

The switches are saved, but the cheats only take effect once the game runs mod code. Until then this mod changes nothing. Only one of the two cheat mods can be on.

conflicts.reason: Both cheat mods patch the same game code on your disc; enable one at a time.

settings.label: Character 2 (CPU) Modifier
settings.description:
Character 2 (CPU) Modifier by 47iscool
Codebreaker v7+
004A78A8 000000??

Your Greatest Hits pnach (the pnach writes FF; your CodeBreaker list leaves the value ?? to choose): 004A78A8 000000FF

On your disc: Works: choose the character of your first CPU partner. ?? is the game's character number, read from your disc: Kevin 00, Mark 01, Jim 02, George 03, David 04, Alyssa 05, Yoko 06, Cindy 07, or FF for no partner (as Go It Alone). Off leaves the game's choice. Applies from the next scenario on, in every scenario of a session: the game clears the players' data when a scenario ends and again when it sets up the next one, then creates the partners from this byte when that scenario starts. A partner is never changed in the middle of a scenario: a choice made during a scenario applies at the next one.

Your Greatest Hits pnach: 4031FB6D 00030001 / FFFFFFFF 00000000

On your disc: Fixed for your disc: the 40 NPCs of your disc's collection become selectable (character select). As written the code fills the bytes 0x0031FB6D-0x0031FB78, one byte off the game's NPC words 0x0031FB6C-0x0031FB77: it misses U.S.S.1, writes a byte outside the NPC words, and turns on dozens of NPC entries no purchase unlocks. The mod sets exactly the bits the game's own unlock code sets for its 20 NPC items. Writes your save data (kept when the game saves), only once your save data is loaded or created. Unlocked things stay unlocked after turning this Off, as with a normal unlock.
